records.name: The  Weighing  Scales
records.source_note: Brussels architectural heritage inventory entry 30991 (La Balance, Rue de la Colline 24) lists 1704, agreeing with the city history text. This is an official reconstruction-date proxy, not a structured original-construction year; human review still required.
records.city_history: Reconstruction in 1704 on the preserved cellars. Restorations in 1890 and 1986; most recent intervention in 2000 with complete reconstruction of the rear façade, following its collapse.
records.identity_note: The City dataset labels this case The Weighing Scales, Grand-Place 24. Heritage inventory Urban 30991 labels La Balance, Rue de la Colline 24, while explicitly treating its facade as part of the Grand-Place ensemble. The British Library caption uses rue de la Colline; Wikimedia Commons describes Grand-Place and supplies protected-monument identifier 2043-0177/0. The City and heritage records share the distinctive 1704, 1890 and 1986 chronology, but the street-address mapping still requires reviewer confirmation.
records.register_observation: Retain 1704 as heritage-inventory reconstruction date, not as an original-construction-year claim. Source comparison: agrees with city reconstruction history. No structured official construction-year field is supplied in this evidence chain.
